key_insight: Giving a language model read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raises quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% with passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of solar-cell measurements require structured experimental records, not just retrieved paper excerpts.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers directly from measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures using an open 14B model on a single 24 GB GPU.
Compare text retrieval with read-only SQL queries over a structured device table.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered 45,441 device records and 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers; SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature.
watch_item: SQL-enabled answers still fail on nearly half the benchmark, and deployment depends on accurate extraction and maintenance of structured records.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
